Three years later, she graduated at the top of her class from flight school, becoming a highly sought-after talent among major airlines. As she pursued her dream of becoming a captain, Ruan Sixian faced numerous trials, while Fu Mingyu encountered multiple obstacles amidst corporate restructuring. Their relationship deepened as their dreams clashed with reality, yet they also drifted apart due to various misunderstandings and challenges.
